Questions? We've Got Answers.

We've put together answers to the most common things people ask.

How does No More Theft work?
No More Theft connect your existing security cameras to an AI learning machine that watches, learners and analyzes your store. When theft/ shoplifting behavior is detected, an alert including video is sent to designated staff in 20 seconds.
What type of internet do I need?
In order for the AI to pull the video feed from your store a static IP address is needed and fiber is preferred. Many of our customers have Cable internet such as Comcast, Spectrum, Road Runner etc. that also works well.
Do I need to replace or upgrade my cameras?
For most clients, No. CCTV systems developed in the late 90’s had the main elements needed. Resolution of 704x480 or greater and RTSP.
What type of businesses can use No More Theft?
Convenience stores, liquor stores, clothing stores, supermarkets, pharmacies, Electronics stores and more.
How fast are the alerts?
20-30 seconds depending on internet speed and the amount of cameras
How does pricing work?
$20/per camera per month for a year. $240 paid upfront no cancellations, no contracts.
Do you have to visit our store?
In most cases, No. With remote support connections to on-site computers, Facetime and Zoom.
What passwords do I need?
We will need administrator passwords to router and the CCTV system.
Exclusive Protection: Detect Shoplifters Across Stores
We have a No More Theft exclusive. For clients that have multiple stores, we have a blacklisting addon that can alert staff that someone who has shoplifted before has entered the premises.
